description: This file defines the QueryThingsResponse class, a final immutable Java class representing the response to a 'QueryThings' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creation from JSON, accessing the search result, and serialization to JSON, along with handling HTTP headers and status codes.

classes.name: QueryThingsResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a 'QueryThings' command, encapsulating search results and response handling logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new QueryThingsResponse instance with given search result and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a QueryThingsResponse object from a JSON string or JSON object and provided headers.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Replaces the entity (search result) in the response with a new one derived from the provided JSON value.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the response with new DittoHeaders.
